I told Dana the date I have is 21 December. Marcus posted it in #north-team on 14 October as the deadline for the signed Thornbury Cloth Co. order form. Nobody in the channel has changed it since, including in the replies to his message.

I couldn't check it any further: I can't see any Thornbury files on the share. So I suggested she confirm the date with Marcus before it goes in the tracker. I replied to her question in a thread in #north-team.
